page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number 279 at top right. Full-width text block with two prayer paragraphs (Secreta, Communio), then a centred heading "CRUCIS EXALTATIO." Below it two parallel columns of verse (left and right), with a catchword-style signature "S 4" and "Ligna" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Secreta : Sacrificium, Domine, quod tibi immolamus, placatus intende, ut ab omni nos eruat bellorum nequitiâ, & per vexillum sanctæ crucis filii tui, ad conterendas adversariorum insidias, nos in tuæ protectionis securitate constituat.
Communio : Per signum crucis de inimicis nostris libera nos Deus noster.
main_text.head: CRUCIS EXALTATIO.

page.notes: Verse printed in two parallel columns; the right column is set after the left, in reading order. Some words in the scan are doubtful and may be misread: "seculâ" and "Dulce lignu" in particular. Several letters of the Latin are blurred by the scan (e.g. "Quatuor", "comprehendit" read from a worn line).
